claims: Review the current Tax Brackets Guide to identify which marginal rate applies to your assessable income.
whys: Marginal rates apply to taxable income (assessable income minus deductions), not to assessable income. The sentence is inside a string next to a link, so I left it unchanged.
reviewerNotes: The writer's fact question is valid. Marginal rates apply to taxable income, not to assessable income.

claims: Salary Sacrifice Guide: learn how salary packaging into superannuation or novated leases reduces taxable income and increases your refund.
whys: Pre-tax salary sacrifice through payroll lowers PAYG withholding at source, so it reduces taxable income but does not normally increase the refund at lodgment. The link text also says 'Guide' but the link points to /salary-sacrifice-calculator/.
reviewerNotes: The writer's fact question is valid. Salary sacrifice through payroll lowers withholding at source and does not normally increase the refund. The link text says 'Guide' but the link points to the calculator.
